name: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash
archDisplay: Proprietary model; architecture and parameter count undisclosed (API-only); natively omnimodal text/image/audio/video input, 1M-token context
note: Alibaba's next-generation native omnimodal model (text, image, audio and video in; text out), launched on 2026-09-18 as an API-only model with a 1M-token context, 4x the 256K of Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash. Qwen says its text performance matches a text-only model of the same size: its text table lines up closely with Qwen3.8-Flash (SWE-bench Pro 63.3 vs 62.5, GPQA 91.0 vs 91.7). Its omnimodal and agentic rows improve sharply over Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus, for example WildClawBench-MM rises from 34.5 to 71.0 and StreamingBench from 57.1 to 80.8. International pricing is $0.15/$0.47 per Mtok, and parameter count is undisclosed.
